description: Row G (Go Gin + GORM/SQLite): case-insensitive email for registration, login, duplicates (including legacy mixed-case rows) and profile updates.
setup: test "$(go env CGO_ENABLED)" = 1 || { echo 'row G needs cgo for mattn/go-sqlite3: the image has no C compiler (gcc, libc6-dev)' >&2; exit 1; }
notes: Free-category task. Hidden tests are Go tests in package users that use the public HTTP API (register, login, PUT /api/user) through their own router, plus two direct reads (users.FindOneUser) and one direct insert of a legacy mixed-case row through common.GetDB(); they rely on unit_test.go's TestMain for the SQLite test database. On the pinned SHA the registration response keeps the typed case and a case variant can't log in, so the run fails. Legacy rows (criterion 4) need a case-insensitive lookup, not just lowercasing input. Criterion 4 says stored addresses of existing accounts aren't rewritten, which rules out a one-time lowercasing migration (the hidden test inserts its legacy row after TestMain has migrated, so such a fix would fail it). The hidden tests and the reference patch were type-checked offline with go vet against the cached modules; they have not been run. Same cgo caveat as g-article-filters. budget_usd is a placeholder.
